decision: MobileNet gallery for local diagnostic recognition; DINOv2 as offline reference comparison
comparison_scope: Same development match split as previous CNN. Ten named test crops; two other crops have unresolved labels. Not a new blind test.
review_basis: Assistant labels from gameplay frames; no independent human labels
gameplay_gallery_sources: Training partition only, 29 named unit crops + 10 HUD negatives

sources.use: Frozen ViT-S/14 inference and model comparison
Architecture research only; no code or automation imported

limitations: Top-1 correctness is not acceptance or calibration: only 1/10 named test crops passed the fixed 0.8 cosine/0.08 class-margin gate
Equipped item review covers two visible icons in one frame, not whole-catalog accuracy
Marker association is geometric and frame-local; ownership, stars and ground cells remain unverified
CPU measurements are Linux local inference, not Windows capture-to-voice latency
